tests: Over-budget additions preserve accepted stops, route, states, distance, history and record callbacks.
Invalid moves and reorders preserve the last valid trip.
Routing failures never commit a candidate or change the score.
Removal, undo and clear operate only on accepted snapshots.
Exactly 1,609,344 m is accepted; an additional centimetre and nontrivial floating overages are rejected.
Late asynchronous responses cannot overwrite a newer accepted edit.
Clearing cancels in-flight work without a ghost stop or route.
Undo during validation cancels the proposal without losing the accepted start.
Personal best ranks unique states first, then actual distance, for eligible trips only.
Only a compatible legacy 1,000-mile record migrates; other old modes, graph versions and over-budget scores do not.
